types.name: MessageProps
types.doc: A full assistant message: avatar, name, formatted content and a bar of actions that appears when the row is hovered or focused. `content` takes a small Markdown subset (paragraphs, bullet and numbered lists, headings, fenced code, `inline code`, **bold**, links); pass `children` instead to render your own content.

members.name: name
members.doc: Sender name shown next to the avatar.

members.name: avatarSrc
members.doc: Image URL for the avatar. Without it (and without `avatar`) a spark mark on the accent is shown.

members.name: avatar
members.doc: Custom avatar element, for a logo or initials. Wins over `avatarSrc`.

members.name: meta
members.doc: Small note after the name, such as the model or the time.

members.name: content
members.doc: Message text in the small Markdown subset described above.

members.name: children
members.doc: Custom content. When given, `content` is only used as the text to copy.

members.name: actions
members.doc: When the action bar shows: on hover or focus, always, or never. Touch screens always show it.

members.name: onCopy
members.doc: Called after the message text was copied.

members.name: onRetry
members.doc: Called when the person asks for another answer. The retry button is hidden without it.

members.name: defaultRating
members.doc: Rating the message starts with when uncontrolled.

members.name: onRatingChange
members.doc: Called when the person rates the answer or clears the rating. The rating buttons are hidden when neither this nor a rating prop is given.

members.name: animateIn
members.doc: Staggers the content blocks in when the message mounts. Turn it off for history.

members.name: className
members.doc: Extra class for the root element.
